nqa entry admin_test test_icmp
 type icmp
 destination ip 10.1.1.1
 source ip 192.168.1.1
 probe count 3
 probe timeout 1000
 frequency 60
nqa entry admin_http test_http
 type http
 destination ip 10.2.2.2
 source ip 192.168.1.1
 probe count 5
 probe timeout 2000
 frequency 120
nqa schedule admin_test test_icmp start-time now lifetime forever
nqa schedule admin_http test_http start-time now lifetime forever
